extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and practitioners involved in peer review and scholarly publishing (editors, publishers, funders, bibliometric/informatics experts, librarians, journalists, policymakers, ethicists, information innovators, and others interested in scientific information quality).
extracted.subtask_description: Submit abstracts of new and original research for presentation at the Tenth International Congress on Peer Review and Scientific Publication (Sept 2-5, 2025). Research should address the quality, credibility, integrity, or dissemination of peer review and scientific publication, and related topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope / Topics solicited
rubrics_metrics.description: Research into the quality and credibility of editorial and funding peer review, scientific and scholarly publication, research and reporting practices, identification and management of biases, transparency, reproducibility, access, publication and dissemination metrics, identification and management of threats to the integrity of science, and advances in information exchange.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Peer Review Congress provides a forum for the presentation and discussion of research in these areas; submissions should fit within this topical scope. The full Call for Research is on the JAMA site (linked from the announcement) where additional topic details may appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The meeting "will feature three days of presentations of new and original research."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should report new and original research (i.e., not previously presented or published in full as the same work). See the full Call for Research on the JAMA site for any additional originality or prior-publication policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstracts will be due on January 31, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit by the stated deadline; consult the JAMA Call for Research for submission portal, required abstract format, word/character limits, and any other procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference theme alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: The Congress theme is "Peer Review and Scientific Publication at a Crossroads."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are expected to align with or speak to the theme where relevant — i.e., address issues of crossroads/transition, challenges, or future directions in peer review and scientific publication — though the announcement also solicits broadly relevant work across the listed topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to intended audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Work should be of interest to editors and publishers of scientific peer-reviewed journals, researchers, funders, bibliometric and informatics experts, information innovators, librarians, journalists, policymakers, ethicists, scientific information disseminators, and anyone interested in the progress of the scientific information enterprise and the quality of scientific evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame submissions to be accessible and useful to these stakeholder groups; emphasize implications for editorial practice, policy, metrics, transparency, integrity, or dissemination where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event logistics (dates and location)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Tenth International Congress on Peer Review and Scientific Publication will be held September 2-5, 2025 in Chicago, Illinois.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan travel and presentation availability for those dates and location. Check the full Call for Research for details on presentation format (oral/poster), scheduling, and registration requirements.
